subject: Request: Senior approval for Stellarix >20% Hosted API usage incentive
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Stellarix request — asking for senior approval on pricing incentive

Team,

Quick summary — Stellarix (AI-driven supply chain analytics) is asking for a deeper-than-normal usage incentive on Hosted API to lock a 12-month committed program. Their ask: 28% off our list Hosted API usage rate for a committed baseline of 9M tokens / month (3-month ramp to 9M).

Why this matters:
- ARR impact: estimated $480k net new ARR in year 1 under the proposed blended rate (they commit to 12 months).
- Strategic upside: Stellarix is willing to 1) do a joint case study + logo + co-marketing, and 2) list Redwood in their partner marketplace (sales motion reach into 150+ enterprise prospects).
- Risk: discount exceeds our standard approval threshold (>20%). Deal desk flagged it and asked for senior signoff.

Attached is the pricing workbook with proforma (stellarix_pricing_workbook.xlsx) and a redlined term sheet they returned (term_sheet_redlined.docx). Key asks from their side:
- 28% volume discount on Hosted API usage
- 60-day SLA credit cap language tweak
- Data residency: want EU residency option (we've offered hosted EU region)

Request: I am asking for approval to offer the 28% usage incentive as a special one-off, contingent on the mutual marketing commitments (case study + marketplace listing) and upfront payment of the first two months. If approved, I will instruct Legal to finalize the term sheet and get DocuSign out.

Economics snapshot (see workbook):
- List rate/unit: $0.0025 per 1k tokens (example)
- Proposed effective rate: ~ $0.0018 per 1k tokens after 28%
- Expected TCO impact vs baseline: ~27% unit margin reduction; payback via 12-month commit and marketplace acceleration.

Asks: Ben — do you have a preliminary view on capacity/ops impact? Mina — would need senior approval for >20% concession. Marissa — can CS commit to the joint case study deliverable and a launch plan?

Thanks,
Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: stellarix_pricing_workbook.xlsx, term_sheet_redlined.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stellarix request — asking for senior approval on pricing incentive

Rafael — thanks for the summary. Quick notes:
- On capacity: product/ops view is that 9M tokens/month is modest and can be handled within hosted pools if we reserve capacity for them; may need a small burst buffer for month-ends.
- Commercially: standard play is up to 20% via Deal Desk. Anything beyond needs senior approval and a clear tieback (marketing, strategic partner value).

Mina — Rafael is asking for 28% with joint marketing. If you want, I can push for 25% as a compromise and keep the case study obligation as written. Rafael — please surface the exact milestone schedule for the case study (draft dates).

-Ben

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Cleary <jordan.cleary@stellarix.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stellarix request — asking for senior approval on pricing incentive

Mina — following up with more color and the customer ask thread (pasted below). They are under competitive pressure from two incumbents and have a procurement window that closes in mid-November. If we don’t move fast, they will take a 9-12 month commitment to a competitor with lower TCO.

Proposed commercial guardrails if leadership signs off at 28%:
1) 12-month minimum commitment; failure to meet monthly baseline triggers true-up at list rates.
2) Upfront payment of two months at signed rate (to reduce churn and initial cash risk).
3) Redwood to receive marketing commitments: case study published within 90 days and partner marketplace listing within 120 days.
4) Limit the deep discount to Hosted API usage (no additional discounts on Dedicated or Private).

Attached: pricing workbook (breakouts by month), redlined term sheet. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/4709

Customer snippet (from Jordan Cleary):
---
From: Jordan Cleary <jordan.cleary@stellarix.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-31T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted API pilot

Rafael,

We appreciate the proposal. Our exec team is looking for a long-term partner and would prefer if Redwood could make an exception on pricing for the first year to help with the internal case. If you can get within 25-30% off list, we'll fast-track procurement. We can commit to a marketing case study and co-sell activities.

Best,
Jordan
---

If it helps the decision: estimated net revenue over 12 months at 28% off = ~$480k; estimated net revenue at 25% = ~$525k (slightly higher because of billing cadence assumptions). I’m requesting approval specifically for 28% so we can close before procurement deadlines.

Thanks for taking a look — would appreciate signoff by end-of-day Tuesday to keep momentum.

Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stellarix request — asking for senior approval on pricing incentive

Folks — reviewed the workbook and the strategic ask. Thank you, Rafael, for the clear guardrails. I will authorize a discretionary concession, but with tighter conditions than requested.

Decision (conditional senior approval):
- Approved discount: up to 25% off list Hosted API usage (not to exceed 25%).
- Conditions:
  1) 9-month minimum committed term (we will accept 9 months given their timeline, with true-up provisions back to list if they underdeliver).
  2) Upfront payment: signed contract + first-month payment due at signing; second month payment within 30 days (we waive further upfront requirements).
  3) Legal must approve the SLA credit language; no uncapped credits. No changes that materially increase our exposure.
  4) CS must execute the case study with a published summary within 90 days. If case study is not completed, the remaining discount beyond 20% will be clawed back pro-rata.
  5) Product/Infra to confirm that the requested baseline can be reserved in our hosted pools; Ben to coordinate.

Please proceed with 25% offer and get Legal/Finance/CS to reflect the conditions. Rafael — copy me on the term sheet update. Ben/Marissa — please confirm operational readiness and the case study owner.

Mina Haddad
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: approval_signoff_mina.pdf
